title: "OPERATION INDEPENDENCE" Fibonacci tile puzzle box with padlock, Utah ranch (12/02/2009)
description: Color photo of a wooden-framed, glass-topped light box containing columns of dark tiles glued to graph paper in a Fibonacci sequence, with loose tiles at the bottom, a label reading "OPERATION INDEPENDENCE," and a padlock held in a hand below; a timestamp reads "12/02/2009 08:14." Text under "Puzzles Requiring Intelligence to Complete" explains the challenge is for any intelligence on the ranch to assemble the next number in the Fibonacci series, with locked boxes stationed in Homestead #2 and the doublewide trailer. A heading (d) below is redacted under 1843(a)(2).
